description: Scored Robinhood Chain buyer bursts from the last 1-24 hours. Each row has its rug check and 30-minute outcome: return at 30 min, peak, the return under each exit rule (2% round-trip costs included) and whether the liquidity was pulled. Outcome fields are labels, not features (see /v1/fields). Data rewritten every 20 s (<= 30 s behind the chain); data older than 120 s is refused with a 503 and not charged. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

lp.description: Rug-check filter: safe = creator cannot pull the liquidity (burned, locker, launchpad or other wallets hold >= 50%); held = creator / LP adder holds >= 50%. Default all.

tier.description: Burst tier (default main for live, all for history)

name: rh_bursts_history
